journal_lines: §lEnderman§l. Kept my eyes down. Came in low.
Tall thing in the field. §oMade a sound like the air pulling apart.§o Stayed calm.
Purple eyes. Looked at my feet. Dealt with it at an angle.
§cTeleported behind me. §oFelt the air move before I heard it.§o Spun. Cleared it.
Watched it from the side of my eyes. No eye contact. Worked out.
Felled it. §oPearl still warm when I picked it up.§o Heavier than it looks.
It moved before I finished blinking. Ears told me where it went.
Strange one. §oHeld a block of dirt in both hands like it mattered.§o Let it keep it until it didn't.
Gone and back twice before I landed a clean hit. Third time stayed gone.
§lEnderman§l in the rain. §oThey don't like the rain.§o Used it.
Didn't look up. Didn't look directly. Came in from the side. Done.
§cShoulder caught its hand when it teleported through me. §oLeft a bruise.§o Kept moving.
